q: According to the book's three-fold classification of regional states that emerged from Mughal decline, which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Independent Kingdoms (e.g., Awadh, Bengal) — states set up directly by rebels against the Mughal empire
Successor States (e.g., Awadh, Bengal, Hyderabad) — provinces that broke away in practice while nominally not challenging Mughal sovereignty
The New States (e.g., Mysore, Rajput states) — provinces destabilised from within Mughal control
All three categories describe identical processes with no meaningful distinction
